messages:
maria chen: Heads-up — saw quota graphs in the admin console spike with another customer's usage after a canary fallback this morning. not catastrophic but very confusing for support.
sara klein: ugh. can you repro? steps?
maria chen: yes. steps: 1) open org A admin -> quota dashboard 2) rapid org switch to org B via topbar 3) trigger a handful of bulk embedding jobs on org B (~20 requests) 4) switch back to org A and refresh the quota tab. sometimes the counts for org A show B's usage for a minute.
leo wang: that sounds like a telemetry attribution issue. are we sure it's UI-only (stale client state) vs actual backend mixup?
maria chen: confirmed UI + backend. support saw logs where the quota-collector emitted a usage sample with org_id=A but payload had B tokens. attached a snippet (sanitized).
leo wang: hmm. two hypotheses: 1) routing fallback path reuses a shared in-memory cache key and doesn't rebind the org header, 2) exporter batching window merges samples without org tag. either could result in crossed attribution.
ajay singh: leaning to (1). we recently changed the canary/router to fallback to cheaper model pool and added a path that rewrites X-Route-Affinity internally. there was a note in the PR about reusing context carriers to avoid allocations.
sara klein: can you paste the PR? maybe the carrier pooling is the culprit.
ajay singh: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/repo/pulls/5218 (server/router: affinity fallback + carrier pool). see lines ~210 where carrier gets cleared conditionally.
maria chen: repro logs (sanitized):
```
INFO quota-collector: enqueue sample org_id=org-A tokens=120 route=affinity-fallback carrier_id=pool-42
INFO quota-collector: emit sample org_id=org-A tokens=120 tags=[...payload-org=B...]
```
sara klein: that payload-org bit is the embedded request metadata from the inference side, right? if carrier is reused it could leave the old request's metadata in the body.
leo wang: exactly. exporter/batcher uses sample.carrier.payload without deep-cloning; carrier pooling + race = stale fields.
ajay singh: timeline: we rolled the router change last night to 10% canary. fallback path only exercised under load spikes; that's why it's intermittent.
ops-oncall: deploy-bot: deploy 2026-03-21T08:12 -> router-service v2.4.1 canary@10% (sha: abcd1234)
deploy-bot: rollback suggested? :warning:
sara klein: we should hotfix. minimal fix: ensure carrier.reset() clears payload or make quota-collector copy payload before enqueue. which approach cheaper to patch quickly?
leo wang: quickest is to copy payload at enqueue point. patch in quota-collector is small and low-risk. then revert carrier pooling in router in next release with test.
ajay singh: I can open a hotfix PR for quota-collector now. will add a unit test that simulates pooled carriers leaking fields.
maria chen: for mitigation, can we add a short TTL on the UI for quota graphs that marks samples as "unverified" for 30s after a roll? would reduce customer confusion.
sara klein: good UX stopgap. also add alerting: a query that looks for samples where sample.org_id != sample.payload.org_hint.
ops-oncall: created PagerDuty alert rule "quota-attr-mismatch" and set to P2 for now.
ajay singh: hotfix PR: https://git.internal/redwood/repo/pulls/5220 (quota-collector: clone payload before enqueue). requesting quick review from @leo @sara.
leo wang: reviewing now.
leo wang: quick note — also instrument router to emit carrier pool checkout/return events with carrier_id. if we can correlate leak windows to pool-42 being reused we get a smoking gun.
maria chen: added a screenshot to the ticket showing the dashboard confusion and support transcript.
sara klein: rollout plan: 1) merge hotfix to canary and promote to 50% 2) monitor metrics for attribution mismatches 3) revert router carrier pooling change in next deploy and add stronger tests 4) long-term: use immutable metadata objects for telemetry paths.
ajay singh: I'm going to merge the hotfix behind a feature flag and push to canary. will post canary ts here.
deploy-bot: deploy request queued: quota-collector v1.12.3-hotfix (sha: deff5678) -> canary 10%
deploy-bot: canary -> 2026-03-21T09:02UTC
maria chen: thanks. backfill: affected support ticket #SUP-4821.
ops-oncall: noted. I'll keep PD on the watchlist.
leo wang: after hotfix merges I'll run a synthetic test that rapidly switches orgs and fires embeddings to see if we can repro.
sara klein: assign follow-ups: @ajay fix (router revert + tests), @leo add instrumentation, @maria update support runbook + UI TTL, @ops-oncall monitor alerts.
maria chen: thanks team. :thumbsup:
